'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike Thomas LS Coruscant: Night Club''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Thomas]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Night Club (Virtual Block 5)|VB5-L-coruscantnightclub-pre.gif|label=Coruscant: Night Club}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael Thomas
* '''Deck name:''' Two-Two
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
